lines: “时间会证明我对雪儿的一片赤诚，雪儿不弃，我一生皆依”林琅天诚恳的表态。
“哼，现在你肯定会这样说，以后要是让我发现你有一丁点对小雪不好，我一定不会放过你”
君怡冰声音远去，人已不见。
“靠，搞什么鬼，故意跑来放几个屁，就跑了？”
回到庭趣阁后，想到君怡雪脸上的异状，林琅天内心呼唤系统。
“系统，出来”
“宿主，你有什么事，本系统忙着呢”
“忙？系统你能有什么忙的”林琅天疑惑不解，头一回听到系统说忙的。
“哼，宿主，这你就不知道了吧，本系统视察诸天万界，每天都在尽阅各个世界的风土人情，趣味着呢？”
“我靠，系统你这么牛逼？在这里能探视诸天寰宇”
“废话”
“大爷果真牛逼轰轰，那系统大爷岂不是可知天下事？”
“那必须的啊”系统一脸傲娇！“
那系统你帮我看看，君怡雪脸上的异状怎么解决?”
“系统？怎么样？”林琅天焦心了。
“喂，你不是说自己遍照寰宇，监察诸天的吗？怎么？难住了？”林琅天催促道；
“宿主，你好吵，你能不能安静一点，我刚才在忙着探查呢，你一直吵吵吵，烦死了”
林琅天：……
“怎么样，有解决的方法吗？”林琅天唯唯诺诺的问道，没办法，系统说了算。
“本系统出手，自然是手到擒来，只是宿主的无能，本系统也是巧妇难为无米之炊”
“我靠，系统你玩人身攻击？”
“宿主难道不是无能，要是有能力需要请我出手？”
“咳…，系统说正事”林琅天一阵尴尬；
“宿主，经过系统探查，君怡雪身上的黑斑来自黑暗异端，
出手之人是帝尊境，要解决的话，以目前的状况来看，可行方法有三种”

content_en:
"Time will prove my sincerity towards Xue'er. I will never give up on Xue'er, and I will always rely on her," Lin Langtian said sincerely.
"Hmph, you will definitely say that now. If I find out that you are not good to Xiaoxue at all in the future, I will definitely not let you go."
Jun Yibing's voice faded away, and the person was gone.
"Damn, what the hell, did you come here on purpose and fart a few times, and then run away?"
After returning to Tingqu Pavilion, thinking of the strange appearance on Jun Yixue's face, Lin Langtian called the system in his heart.
"System, come out"
"Host, what do you want? This system is busy."
"Busy? How can you be busy with the system?" Lin Langtian was puzzled. This was the first time he heard the system say he was busy.
"Hmph, host, you don't know this, right? This system inspects all the worlds and reads the customs and customs of each world every day. How fun is that?"
"Damn, are you so awesome at the system? You can visit all the world here."
"Bullshit"
"The uncle is really awesome. Then doesn't the system uncle know the world's affairs?"
"That's necessary." The system looked arrogant! "
Then help me take a look at the system, how to solve the abnormality on Jun Yixue’s face?”
…
"System? How is it?" Lin Langtian was worried.
"Hey, didn't you say that you shine all over the world and monitor the heavens? What? Are you confused?" Lin Langtian urged;
"Host, you are so noisy, could you please be quiet? I was busy investigating just now, and you are so noisy that I am really annoyed."
Lin Langtian:......
"How is it? Is there a solution?" Lin Langtian asked solemnly. There was no way, the system had the final say.
"When this system takes action, it is naturally easy to capture. It is just the incompetence of the host. This system is also a skillful woman who cannot make a meal without straw."
"Holy shit, are you trying to attack the system personally?"
"Isn't the host incompetent? If he is capable, he needs to ask me to take action?"
"Ahem..., the system is talking about business." Lin Langtian was embarrassed for a while;
"Host, after systematic investigation, the black spots on Jun Yixue's body come from dark heretics.
The person who took action is at the Emperor Senior level. If we want to solve the problem, judging from the current situation, there are three possible methods."
"First of all, only those who are at the Emperor Senior Realm can make the move, and only if their cultivation level is one level higher can they be absolutely sure.
